title: Only Murders Plans New York Return for Potential Season 7
excerpt:
John Hoffman says the series would return to New York if renewed.
Season six premieres December 8, 2026.
body_md:
At the London premiere of Only Murders in the Building season six, co-creator John Hoffman said the series would return to New York if renewed for a seventh season. Steve Martin also identified returning to the city as the team's current goal.

The writers' room has relocated to New York after six seasons in Los Angeles. Hoffman emphasized that New York is central to the show's identity, while its London adventure demonstrated that the format can travel to other cities.

Season six takes Charles, Oliver and Mabel to London for a new murder investigation involving Cinda Canning, played by Tina Fey. The cast includes David Tennant, Martin Freeman, Nicola Coughlan, Simone Ashley, Olivia Colman and Meryl Streep.

The sixth season premieres December 8, 2026, on Hulu and internationally on Disney+. Returning to New York remains a conditional creative plan rather than an official seventh-season renewal.
